scenes.title_en: Light-Blue Shadow and a Dreamy Gaze
scenes.context: 千禧年复古妆：前两色眼影里的眼神。浅蓝色眼影配上迷离的眼神，是千禧年复古妆的标志。语域：美妆展示，氛围描述。
sentences: 前两色眼影里的眼神。
The gaze beneath layers of light-blue eyeshadow.
layers of eyeshadow（眼影层次）
浅蓝色眼影加上迷离的眼神。
Light-blue shadow paired with a dreamy gaze.
a dreamy gaze（迷离眼神）
千禧年复古妆，慵懒又有氛围感。
A Y2K retro look — lazy yet atmospheric.
Y2K retro look（千禧年复古妆）
paraphrase: 迷离眼神 → a dreamy gaze / hazy eyes
千禧年复古 → Y2K retro / millennium revival
scenes.speak: The gaze beneath layers of light-blue eyeshadow. Light-blue shadow paired with a dreamy gaze. A Y2K retro look — lazy yet atmospheric.

scenes.context: 眼神特写：微眯放空，有一种慵懒感。复古滤镜加上粤语BGM，氛围感拉满。语域：美妆展示，氛围描述。
sentences: 眼神特写，微眯放空，慵懒感。
An eye close-up, slightly squinted and unfocused — a lazy feel.
slightly squinted（微眯）；unfocused（放空）
复古滤镜加粤语BGM，氛围感拉满。
Retro filter plus Cantonese BGM — atmosphere dialed to the max.
atmosphere dialed up（氛围感拉满）
整体慵懒又高级。
The whole look feels lazy yet high-end.
lazy yet high-end（慵懒又高级）
paraphrase: 微眯 → slightly squinted / half-closed eyes
氛围拉满 → atmosphere dialed to the max / full vibes
dialed to the max · full vibes
scenes.speak: An eye close-up, slightly squinted and unfocused — a lazy feel. Retro filter plus Cantonese BGM — atmosphere dialed to the max. The whole look feels lazy yet high-end.

scenes.title_cn: 清透显白 + 复古定格
scenes.context: 浅蓝眼影清透显白，迷离眼神上镜。千禧年复古感在这一刻定格。语域：美妆展示，收尾。
sentences: 浅蓝眼影清透显白。
Light-blue shadow looks clear and brightening.
clear and brightening（清透显白）
迷离眼神，上镜很有神。
The dreamy gaze photographs with real spark.
photographs with spark（上镜有神）
千禧年复古感，就此定格。
The Y2K-retro mood, frozen right here.
frozen right here（就此定格）
paraphrase: 清透显白 → clear and brightening / sheer and bright
scenes.speak: Light-blue shadow looks clear and brightening. The dreamy gaze photographs with real spark. The Y2K-retro mood, frozen right here.

practice: Light-blue shadow paired with a dreamy gaze — a Y2K retro look.
Slightly squinted and unfocused — a lazy feel, atmosphere to the max.

pitfalls: Slightly squinted and unfocused — a lazy feel.

「氛围感拉满」用 atmosphere dialed to the max。

The Y2K-retro mood, frozen right here.
